obligations.behavior: Research artifact prompt rendering turns a deterministic research run plan into stable role-specific prompt documents that include researcher id, alignment, question, required sources, allowed capabilities, output path, and research-card JSON output contract metadata.
Each rendered run includes a deterministic idiom artifact command recipe using --prompt-file, --output, --json-out, --report-out, --no-tools, and --mechanical-repair without executing the command.

idiom product research --render-prompts writes deterministic prompt files under an effort-relative prompt directory, exposes JSON metadata, reuses explicit profile selection semantics, and does not run models, write researcher outputs, merge evidence, or draft PRDs.

The prompt rendering surface records only profile identifiers, researcher metadata, prompt/output paths, command recipes, counts, and typed findings; durable reports and state do not embed rendered prompt bodies, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, or customer-identifying data.
obligations.command: privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts
